findings.issue: Technical decisions section ('Технические решения') still lists 9 items, several of which are HOW-level (try/except wrapping shape, regex-vs-NLP-tokenizer choice). Round-1 reduction kept the list size at 9; the change is in framing (design rationale) not in count.
findings.why_matters: User-spec → tech-spec hand-off: the next agent has fewer decisions left to make. Not blocking because the items are now phrased as architectural rationale supporting WHY (split A+B, new module, single call site, mandatory @handle), not implementation procedures.
findings.fix: Optional follow-up: move 'try/except shape' and 'regex vs NLP-tokenizer' decisions to tech-spec.md when it is authored; keep only WHY-level architectural choices in user-spec.

findings.issue: AC numbering is out of sequence: AC1–AC4, AC14, AC5–AC11, AC12, AC13, AC14a, AC15, AC16. Reader has to mentally re-sort to validate coverage.
findings.why_matters: Doesn't change adequacy of the design — the criteria themselves are sound — but harder to audit completeness. A doc-quality issue, more appropriate for quality-validator than adequacy.
findings.fix: Renumber sequentially within sections (variant A, variant B, negatives, boundary, regression). Preserve the AC content verbatim, just fix the numbers.

summary: All four round-1 major findings are resolved. (1) Tech-spec leakage: file:line refs removed, regex literal in AC15 removed, _MAX_BOILERPLATE_LEN now defers to tech-spec ('детали — в tech-spec'), FILES list invariant gone. (2) Prompt-only alternative: new 'Альтернативы' section explicitly evaluates 3 simpler options (prompt-only, variant A only, status quo) and rejects them with concrete reasoning, then justifies the chosen hybrid. (3) Trigger path (auto vs manual): line 12 + line 17 explicitly document auto-path scope and exclude hw_review with reference to hw_review.py:569-662; matches interview Q23 confirming leak source = auto-publish. (4) AC15 umbrella regex now mandates @handle (renumbered AC11) — explicit prose 'обязательным @handle, чтобы не зацепить журналистские отсылки', with AC14a covering '(см. фото в Instagram)' / '(трансляция шла на YouTube)' negatives. Two minor follow-ups remain (residual decisions-section depth, AC numbering disorder) but neither blocks adequacy approval.
